description.value: Established in 2015, The Bee's Knees Cafe is a community-rooted cafe and catering operation in central/south Nanaimo, notable for being one of the only spots on Vancouver Island to serve authentic Persian cuisine alongside espresso drinks and house-baked goods. Everything is made from scratch using locally sourced ingredients, with a strong commitment to vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. The cafe has grown to two locations and is a well-loved neighbourhood hub with outdoor seating.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the OSM address (104-525 Third Street, Nanaimo), provides a phone number not in OSM, and establishes the business as an active cafe/catering operation. The menu and sourcing pages explicitly list numerous vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free items, and the sourcing page confirms this as a core speciality. No bike-specific amenities (rack, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name 'The Bee's Knees Cafe' differs from website branding 'The Bees Knees Cafe & Catering' (missing apostrophe and '& Catering' suffix).

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible cafe in Nanaimo with a confirmed website, address, and phone number. Strong cyclist-relevant food options (vegetarian, vegan, GF, Persian dishes, baked goods).
